english.name: Overdose
english.description: Start the 'Double or Nothing' mode 10 times.

schinese.name: 过量
schinese.description: 开始“Double or Nothing”模式 10 次。

english.name: Nope!
english.description: Cash out immediately in 'Double or Nothing'.

schinese.name: 不了！
schinese.description: 在“Double or Nothing”中立刻兑现离场。

english.name: 140K
english.description: Double your earnings in 'Double or Nothing' and win.

schinese.name: 140K
schinese.description: 在“Double or Nothing”中把收益翻倍并获胜。

english.name: 1000K
english.description: Cash out over 1,000,000 in 'Double or Nothing'.

schinese.name: 1000K
schinese.description: 在“Double or Nothing”中兑现超过 1,000,000。

english.name: Coin Flip
english.description: Successfully shoot yourself with a blank, facing 50/50 odds.

schinese.name: 抛硬币
schinese.description: 在 50/50 概率下成功朝自己发射一发空弹。

english.name: Know When To Quit
english.description: Lose more than 1000K in 'Double or Nothing'.

schinese.name: 懂得何时收手
schinese.description: 在“Double or Nothing”中亏掉超过 1000K。

english.name: Full House
english.description: Use all items in a single turn in 'Double or Nothing'.

schinese.name: 满堂红
schinese.description: 在“Double or Nothing”的单个回合中使用所有物品。

english.name: Why?
english.description: Uncover a live round with the magnifier and shoot yourself.

schinese.name: 为什么？
schinese.description: 用放大镜确认实弹后朝自己开枪。

english.name: Soak It In
english.description: Listen to the music in the nightclub for over a minute.

schinese.name: 沉浸其中
schinese.description: 在夜店听音乐超过一分钟。

english.name: Going Out With Style!
english.description: Saw off the barrel, shoot yourself, and die.

schinese.name: 有型退场！
schinese.description: 锯短枪管，朝自己开枪并死亡。
